_meta.note: A stdio MCP mount completing a ROUND TRIP. session/new carried one element shaped exactly as acp.session_mcp.acp_server_element emits -- name, command, args, env -- pointing at a minimal stdio MCP server whose one tool returns a fixed marker. The session was created and the turn carries tool_call and tool_call_update for that tool, with the marker in the result. The server's own side agrees: it was asked initialize, notifications/initialized, tools/list and tools/call. So the transport is mounted, the tools are enumerated and the tool is REACHABLE -- not merely that an element was accepted. Two things ride along. The tool name is this harness's own MCP grammar, <serverName>__<toolName>, a DOUBLE underscore and no mcp__ prefix, and it appears both in the title and, separately, as toolName and extensionName under _meta.goose.toolCall -- so unlike a harness whose fused title is the only channel, the pair is on the wire here. And a permission request fired for this MCP call too, so the mode covers Crew's own tools and not just builtins. Reductions: ids replaced with fixed synthetic values; catalog cut as in the handshake file; session_info_update and available_commands_update dropped; the tool_call frame's _meta reduced per key to the toolName and extensionName pair it is cited for, derived from the capture through the same helper as every other tool_call frame.
